app.name: Money Tracker
designGoals: Show key money totals at a glance
Make adding a transaction or transfer quick
Keep forms and lists readable in light and dark modes

centerActions.style: elevated rounded split control with a full-height vertical divider and bottom clearance
centerActions.behavior: Each half is independently tappable and opens a form above the current tab.

sharedComponents.panel: Rounded surface card with 20 dp padding and subtle elevation
sharedComponents.pageHeader: Large title, optional supporting subtitle and optional actions
sharedComponents.listItem: Leading circular icon, title, one-line subtitle and optional trailing value or action
sharedComponents.input: Filled outlined field; view-only mode shows a label and value
sharedComponents.select: Filled dropdown; view-only mode shows a label and value
sharedComponents.dateField: Tappable row that opens a date picker
sharedComponents.error: Inline error text using the theme error color

splash.title: Money Tracker
splash.subtitle: Know where your money stands
splash.layout: Centered logo, title, subtitle and loading indicator
splash.onError: Show message and Try again button

home.title: Overview
home.subtitle: Current date and This month
home.layout: Vertical dashboard with prominent balance, monthly flow, financial position, accounts and recent activity

content: Five latest transactions, transfers or tax payments

history.title: History
history.subtitle: Every money movement in one place
history.interaction: Tap a transaction to edit or delete it; tax payments and transfers are read-only in this list.

settings.title: Settings
notes: Changing display currency does not convert stored amounts.

transactionForm.title: New transaction
transactionForm.presentation: Full screen pushed from the Add half of the center control

transferForm.title: Transfer money
transferForm.presentation: Full screen pushed from the Transfer half of the center control

owe.title: Owe
owe.content: Pending money to receive and repay, with amount and optional due date
owe.interaction: Tap an item, choose an account, and mark it completed.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.content: Account list with name, type and calculated balance

categories.title: Categories
categories.content: Nested income, expense or both categories

interactionRules: Show local currency code next to formatted amounts.
Show a confirmation dialog before irreversible deletion.
Show inline validation and database errors near the relevant form.
Use the same layout and readable contrast in light and dark themes.
